title: Announcements
description: Send messages or tasks to school and regional administrators and track who read and who completed them.
emptyHint: Send the first one with the “New announcement” button.
formDescription: The message appears in the recipients’ bell.

kindHints.TASK: With a due date; the recipient presses “Done”.

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: E.g. School 12, please update a student’s data
form.bodyPlaceholder: Describe what needs to be done
form.linkHint: A path inside the system, e.g. /persons/123?edit=1 — it opens when clicked.

detail.description: Read and completion status for each recipient.

gaps.title: Schools with incomplete data
gaps.description: Students without a photo or without a parent phone. “Remind” sends a task to the school administrator; once the gap is fixed, the task closes itself.
